## 7. Stop / hold conditions
- **Hold on key rotation** until all 3 downstream services are migrated
  and verified — this is the single most important constraint in this
  handoff.
- If anything is ambiguous about which services still call the old
  endpoints, stop and confirm rather than guessing — an incomplete
  migration list + early key rotation is the likely failure mode here.
- Escalate to [your name / backup contact] if a production incident

- [ ] Scope is limited to downstream migration on `oauth-migration`;
